kerolox.name: Kerosene + LOX
kerolox.special: Cheap and compact. The weakest of the three.

methalox.name: Methane + LOX
methalox.special: Can be made on Mars from ice and CO₂ (Sabatier), so it can refuel the return.

hydrolox.name: Hydrogen + LOX
hydrolox.special: The most efficient, but it boils off slowly during the cruise and needs huge tanks.

sl.name: Sea-level nozzle
sl.note: Short bell tuned for 1 atm. Strong off the pad, wasteful in vacuum.

vac.name: Vacuum nozzle
vac.note: Long bell tuned for vacuum. Efficient in space, weak and unstable at sea level.
